title: ngpbh: threshold statistics and peaks theory for the PBH abundance with local non-Gaussianity
description: Threshold statistics and peaks theory (including maxima of the non-Gaussian compaction function) for the primordial black hole abundance with local non-Gaussianity and broad spectra; scalar-induced gravitational waves with their primordial non-Gaussian corrections and the NANOGrav 15-year free-spectrum likelihood; scripts reproducing every table and figure of the accompanying note (docs/note), including the R map and the PTA tension per statistic.
